method: Saved Chrome geometry checks at 1440 × 1000 and 390 × 844 CSS pixels. The minimum text size covers the visible interface selectors used by browser-layout.js.
limitations: The narrow viewport is desktop Chrome at devicePixelRatio 1; it is not a physical-phone test.
The aspect-ratio comparison is numerical. The larger score asset is measured at its natural dimensions.

desktop.method: Chrome at the recorded CSS viewport; a narrow viewport does not establish physical phone behavior.

narrow_viewport.method: Chrome at the recorded CSS viewport; a narrow viewport does not establish physical phone behavior.
